Image / video patch embedding

Split visual inputs into spatiotemporal patches and add interpolated positional embeddings.

Image/video patches[N,3,2,16,16]N is the total visual patch count; the processor adapts static images for temporal patches.
↓
Conv3d patch projection[N,1152]kernel=stride=(2,16,16), with bias.
↓
Add interpolated positional embeddings[N,1152]The learned 2304×1152 table corresponds to a base 48×48 grid. Visual RoPE acts on Q/K inside each block; it is not added to patch inputs.

×27

Vision Transformer

16 attention heads, head_dim=72; two pre-LayerNorm residual branches.

Inputs from

LayerNorm → fused QKV[N,3,16,72]qkv is 3456×1152 with bias; Q/K use 2D visual RoPE.
↓
Vision attention → projection + residual[N,1152]Attention is grouped by visual frame/image, not language-style causal attention.
↓
LayerNorm → fc1 → GELU → fc2 + residual[N,1152]1152→4304→1152; all Linear layers have bias.
  • Outputs at indices 8, 16 and 24 branch into three separate DeepStack mergers, corresponding to vision blocks 9, 17 and 25.

×36

Language decoder block

GQA + SwiGLU with two pre-RMSNorm residual branches.

Inputs from

RMSNorm → Q / K / VQ:[B,T,32,128]; K/V:[B,T,8,128]Q 4096→4096; K/V each 4096→1024; all bias-free.
↓
Per-head Q/K RMSNorm → interleaved MRoPEQ:[B,T,32,128]; K:[B,T,8,128]q_norm/k_norm each have only 128 parameters, with scales shared across heads; MRoPE sections=[24,20,20].
↓
Causal GQA → O projection + residual[B,T,4096]32 query heads / 8 KV heads; groups of 4 Q heads share K/V; O is 4096×4096.
↓
RMSNorm → SwiGLU + residual[B,T,4096]SiLU(gate(x)) × up(x), both branches 4096→12288, down 12288→4096; no bias.
  • After layers 0, 1 and 2, add the corresponding DeepStack features at visual positions using a mask; no additional cross-attention.
